language: English (the common tongue of Eym); proper names from Pathfinder 2e canon

galacticBand.name: Desna's Path
galacticBand.description: The bright band of the home galaxy across the sky; a name some Golarion cultures give it, after Desna, goddess of stars and travelers.

note: Star ids index data/stellar/starfield.json (star-0001 is the brightest). Lines are drawn between listed stars. Hemisphere and declination are relative to Eym's celestial equator; the path of the sun is Eym's orbital plane. 'discovered' figures were found in the generated stars; 'sculpted' ones were made by nudging spare stars into a template.

poleStar.name: Cynosure
poleStar.description: The pole star: it holds steady and marks north while the sky turns around it. Desna's palace is said to sit at its heart.

namedStars.name: Pulura
namedStars.description: The brightest star in the sky, high in the north in the Shepherd: the lost traveller's guide, named for the Shimmering Maiden.

namedStars.name: Reaper
namedStars.description: The blade of the Scythe, on the path of the sun; one corner of the Wayfarer's Triangle.

namedStars.name: Sower
namedStars.description: The share of the Plough, on the path of the sun; one corner of the Wayfarer's Triangle.

namedStars.name: Brim
namedStars.description: The bright lip of the Ladle, high in the north.

namedStars.name: Gleam
namedStars.description: The Pike's eye, on the path of the sun.

namedStars.name: Ketephys
namedStars.description: The brightest star of the Stag, named for the Hunter.

namedStars.name: Carter
namedStars.description: The driver of the Wagon.

namedStars.name: Elderlamp
namedStars.description: The brighter of the Twin Lamps in the Windmill; one corner of the Wayfarer's Triangle.

namedStars.name: Doorpost
namedStars.description: The bright post of the Hinge, near the celestial equator.

namedStars.name: Younglamp
namedStars.description: The fainter of the Twin Lamps in the Windmill.

namedStars.name: Ashava
namedStars.description: A brilliant star that belongs to no figure, named for the True Spark of lonely spirits.

namedStars.name: Cartwheel
namedStars.description: A wheel of the Wagon.

namedStars.name: Vigil
namedStars.description: A bright lone star keeping watch north of the path of the sun.

namedStars.name: Hearthfire
namedStars.description: The brightest of the Hearthstones in the Staff, on the path of the sun.

namedStars.name: Latch
namedStars.description: The second star of the Hinge.

namedStars.name: Ripple
namedStars.description: The brightest star of the Eel, high in the north.

namedStars.name: Southlight
namedStars.description: The Wishbone's bright star deep in the south: the southern sky's guide, as there is no southern pole star.

namedStars.name: Fang
namedStars.description: The Adder's fang, on the path of the sun.

namedStars.name: Axle
namedStars.description: The axle of the Wagon.

namedStars.name: Sandfall
namedStars.description: A bright star of the Hourglass, near Cynosure.

namedStars.name: Wayfire
namedStars.description: A lone bright star on the empty road of the sun; it marks the mansion of the Watchfire.

namedStars.name: Cynosure
namedStars.description: The pole star: it holds steady and marks north while the sky turns around it. Desna's palace is said to sit at its heart.

constellations.name: Abadar's Crossbow
constellations.description: The crossbow of Abadar, god of cities and trade: a bent prod across a long stock.

constellations.name: Cayden's Tankard
constellations.description: The tankard of Cayden Cailean: four stars in an open V.

constellations.name: Desna's Butterfly
constellations.description: The butterfly of Desna, goddess of stars and travelers: two pairs of wings on a slender body.

constellations.name: Erastil's Bow
constellations.description: The longbow of Erastil, god of farming and the hunt; the sun passes through it.

constellations.name: Gozreh's Trident
constellations.description: The trident of Gozreh, god of nature, weather and the sea: a shaft splitting into tines.

constellations.name: Iomedae's Sword
constellations.description: The longsword of Iomedae: a long blade with a short crossguard near its top.

constellations.name: Sarenrae's Scimitar
constellations.description: The scimitar of Sarenrae, goddess of the sun: a curved blade above a short hilt and crossguard.

constellations.name: The Adder
constellations.description: A small zigzag serpent on the path of the sun.

constellations.name: The Anchor
constellations.description: A ringed shank with a crossbar stock and two curved flukes.

constellations.name: The Arrow
constellations.description: A long shaft with a barbed head at one end and fletching at the other.

constellations.name: The Beggar
constellations.description: A crooked figure with a bent arm.

constellations.name: The Bell
constellations.description: A bell with sloping shoulders and a flared lip around its clapper.

constellations.name: The Bolt
constellations.description: A jagged stroke like lightning.

constellations.name: The Chain
constellations.description: Links hanging down to a bright pair.

constellations.name: The Crane
constellations.description: A long-legged bird near the southern pole.

constellations.name: The Crook
constellations.description: A shepherd's crook with a bent head.

constellations.name: The Crown
constellations.description: A half-ring of seven stars, like a circlet seen from the side.

constellations.name: The Eel
constellations.description: A long wavering line of stars in the northern sky.

constellations.name: The Ferryman
constellations.description: A figure leaning on a long pole; Irori's Belt crosses him.

constellations.name: The Fishhook
constellations.description: A line with a barbed hook at its end.

constellations.name: The Heron
constellations.description: An arched neck curling into a loop.

constellations.name: The Hinge
constellations.description: Three bright stars bent at a joint.

constellations.name: The Horseshoe
constellations.description: An open bent shape like a horseshoe.

constellations.name: The Hourglass
constellations.description: Two triangles meeting at Cynosure, the pole star; the whole figure turns around its waist through the night.

constellations.name: The Kite
constellations.description: Four stars in a lopsided diamond.

constellations.name: The Ladder
constellations.description: Two rails joined by three rungs.

constellations.name: The Ladle
constellations.description: A long handle ending in a small bent bowl.

constellations.name: The Lantern
constellations.description: A hanging ring above a tall lantern body.

constellations.name: The Lyre
constellations.description: Two curved arms rising from a base and joined by a crossbar.

constellations.name: The Mast
constellations.description: A tall upright with a spar to one side.

constellations.name: The Pike
constellations.description: A long straight fish whose tail forks at the lower end.

constellations.name: The Plough
constellations.description: A crooked share and handle lying on the path of the sun.

constellations.name: The Ribbon
constellations.description: A long S-shaped curve of stars.

constellations.name: The Scythe
constellations.description: A short blade with a long handle; the sun passes through it.

constellations.name: The Shepherd
constellations.description: A walking figure high in the north, led by the brightest star in the sky.

constellations.name: The Ship
constellations.description: A hull with a raised stern and bow beneath a single triangular sail.

constellations.name: The Sling
constellations.description: A small forked sling.

constellations.name: The Spindle
constellations.description: A long narrow spindle on the path of the sun.

constellations.name: The Staff
constellations.description: A short walking staff on the path of the sun, holding the Hearthstones.

constellations.name: The Stag
constellations.description: A standing stem with branching antlers above.

constellations.name: The Swan
constellations.description: A bird with outstretched neck and wings.

constellations.name: The Tent
constellations.description: Three stars in a clean triangle, low in the south.

constellations.name: The Throne
constellations.description: A high back above a broad seat.

constellations.name: The Wagon
constellations.description: A long wagon bed with its tongue reaching out to one side.

constellations.name: The Windmill
constellations.description: Crossed sails around the Twin Lamps.

constellations.name: The Wishbone
constellations.description: A forked bone with a short stem, low in the south.

constellations.name: The Yoke
constellations.description: A shallow bowed beam on the path of the sun.

constellations.name: Torag's Hammer
constellations.description: The warhammer of Torag, god of the forge: a broad head on a long haft.

asterisms.name: The Twin Lamps
asterisms.description: Two brilliant stars side by side, the most striking pair in the sky.

asterisms.name: The Hearthstones
asterisms.description: A tight knot of bright stars on the path of the sun.

asterisms.name: The Wayfarer's Triangle
asterisms.description: A great triangle of three of the brightest stars, straddling the celestial equator and seen from both hemispheres.

asterisms.name: Irori's Belt
asterisms.description: Three evenly spaced stars of similar brightness in a straight row, the belt of Irori.

lunarMansions.name: The Yoke-Pin
lunarMansions.description: The bright pin of the Yoke, where the year's mansions begin.

lunarMansions.name: The Ox
lunarMansions.description: The faint stars trailing the Yoke, the beast in harness.

lunarMansions.name: The Ploughshare
lunarMansions.description: The blade of the Plough, beside the Adder's coils.

lunarMansions.name: The Furrow
lunarMansions.description: A dim stretch behind the Plough, the turned earth.

lunarMansions.name: The Hearth
lunarMansions.description: The Hearthstones in the Staff, a tight knot of bright stars.

lunarMansions.name: The Smoke
lunarMansions.description: A few faint stars rising beyond the Hearth.

lunarMansions.name: The Well
lunarMansions.description: A lone modest star in an open field of sky.

lunarMansions.name: The Beacon
lunarMansions.description: A brilliant solitary star that belongs to no figure.

lunarMansions.name: The Shallows
lunarMansions.description: A bright star just ahead of the Pike.

lunarMansions.name: The Pike's Eye
lunarMansions.description: The brightest star of the Pike.

lunarMansions.name: The Weir
lunarMansions.description: Open sky past the Pike's tail.

lunarMansions.name: The Net
lunarMansions.description: A loose scatter of middling stars.

lunarMansions.name: The Distaff
lunarMansions.description: The Spindle, where thread is spun.

lunarMansions.name: The Loom
lunarMansions.description: A bright star on the edge of the path, beyond the Spindle.

lunarMansions.name: The Hollow
lunarMansions.description: An almost empty stretch of the path.

lunarMansions.name: The Bowstring
lunarMansions.description: The trailing stars of Erastil's Bow.

lunarMansions.name: The Bow's Belly
lunarMansions.description: The bright curve of Erastil's Bow.

lunarMansions.name: The Quiver
lunarMansions.description: Middling stars beside the Bow.

lunarMansions.name: The Watchfire
lunarMansions.description: A brilliant lone star on the empty road of the sun.

lunarMansions.name: The Thicket
lunarMansions.description: Faint stars clustered off the path.

lunarMansions.name: The Barren Field
lunarMansions.description: The dimmest mansion, with hardly a star to mark it.

lunarMansions.name: The Hedge
lunarMansions.description: A row of middling stars along the empty road.

lunarMansions.name: The Fallow
lunarMansions.description: Faint stars in the heart of the sun's empty road.

lunarMansions.name: The Milestone
lunarMansions.description: A bright star standing at the edge of the path.

lunarMansions.name: The Crossroads
lunarMansions.description: Scattered faint stars where the road turns.

lunarMansions.name: The Gate
lunarMansions.description: A lone star before the Scythe.
